description: Monday, July 20, 2026 WESKAN – State Representative Adam Smith, chair of the House Taxation Committee, unveiled his comprehensive plan to provide property tax relief for all Kansas taxpayers, with an emphasis on primary residential property. The three-part plan includes reducing the statewide mill levy, restricting future tax increases, and safeguarding senior citizens’ homes. REDUCING […]
title: Smith Releases Property Tax Relief Plan - Representative Adam Smith
